maintenance_led.reason: Sells sample storage, biorepository services, GENEWIZ sequencing and cold-storage equipment; mostly recurring services and new sales, not repair of installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are pharma, biotech, CDMOs, and research institutions; revenue mainly from private commercial buyers, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own services and products; acquisitions like UK Biocentre are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: GxP-compliant cryogenic storage of irreplaceable samples and drug products; switching risks chain-of-custody, regulatory requalification, and sample integrity.

notes: Azenta sold its semiconductor automation business; answers cover Life Sciences.
